hook: A chemist's model kit and specimen viewer.
outcome: Model simple molecules and repeated atomic structures, and inspect how connections change shape and material behaviour.
sources: PubChem PUG REST compound records, 32 field-guide molecules and 40 also-known structures. Computed graphs and conformers; public domain numerical molecular records. Fetched 2026-11-05.
OpenStax Chemistry 2e (2019 edition, CC BY 4.0), Flowers, Theopold, Langley and Robinson, 7.6, 10.5, 10.6, 18.3. Current web edition licence differs; no current prose or art reproduced.
Cordero et al. 2008 covalent radii; Bondi 1964 van der Waals radii; Shannon 1976 ionic radii; CRC Handbook 97th ed. lattice parameters. Factual constants, no source illustrations.
Jmol CPK factual colour convention, https://jmol.sourceforge.net/jscolors/.
Illustrations generated with OpenAI gpt-image, edited for Curio Class

CDC NIOSH Ethyl alcohol, https://www.cdc.gov/niosh/npg/npgd0262.html. Factual boiling point, US government public domain.

Coordinate exceptions: H2 uses a 74 pm reference separation. Silane lacks PubChem 3D coordinates and uses ideal tetrahedral geometry with radius-sum Si-H distance 142 pm, explicitly labelled as a model estimate.

Allene analytic fallback: OpenStax Chemistry 2e (2019), chapter 8, exercise on allene hybridization and perpendicular end planes; https://ic.arc.losrios.edu/~paynem/textbook_os_2e/openstax_2e_ch08.pdf. Own ideal coordinates, radius-estimated bond lengths, not a PubChem 3D record.
